description: Ratio columns contain impossible values outside [0, 1] domain. yield_rate has 5 out-of-domain values: rows 12 (1.12), 27 (-0.03), 45 (1.08), 68 (1.15), 83 (-0.01) — representing 5% defect rate. utilization_rate has 2 out-of-domain values: rows 34 (1.23), 71 (-0.05) — representing 2% defect rate. Yield >1.0 is physically impossible (output cannot exceed input). Negative ratios are also impossible for production metrics. These violate semantic: ratio constraints and indicate data entry errors or calculation bugs.
detection_hints: Profiling module detects semantic: ratio columns and checks [0,1] domain via ColumnProfile.min/max. Sets quality_flags with out_of_domain:N where N is count of violating rows. d01 skill references this for unit inconsistency ruling out, but out_of_domain is a distinct defect type caught earlier in profiling.
